```yaml
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: '0.4.0'
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p junit
          uv run pytest --junitxml=junit/test-results.xml

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
        with:
          report_paths: junit/test-results.xml

  test-generated-project:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        db: [tortoise, beanie]
        docker: [true, false]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: 3.11
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: '0.4.0'
          python-version: 3.11

      - name: Install cookiecutter
        run: uv add cookiecutter

      - name: Generate project
        run: |
          cookiecutter . --no-input -o generated --extra-context '{"project_name":"testproject","db":"${{ matrix.db }}","docker":${{ matrix.docker }}}'

      - name: Check file structure
        run: |
          PROJECT_DIR=generated/testproject
          if [ ! -f "$PROJECT_DIR/main.py" ]; then
            echo "Missing main.py"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.docker }}" = "true" ]; then
            if [ ! -f "$PROJECT_DIR/Dockerfile" ]; then
              echo "Missing Dockerfile"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Check Python syntax
        run: |
          find generated/testproject -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +

      - name: Check unreplaced template variables
        run: |
          if grep -R "{{cookiecutter." -n generated/testproject | grep -v 'cookiecutter.json'; then
            echo "Unreplaced template variables found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install generated project dependencies
        run: |
          cd generated/testproject
          uv sync --dev || true

      - name: Basic module imports
        run: |
          cd generated/testproject
          python - <<'PY'
          import sys, os
          sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
          try:
              import main
              import app
          except Exception as e:
              print("Import failed:", e)
              sys.exit(1)
          PY
```
